reply_text:
I couldn't confirm the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co., and I've replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message to say so.

I checked the #central-team history and the public files Pree can see. None of them mention Brackenwater, its renewal date or any Brackenwater contract or CRM files. In the reply I thanked her, said I'd noted the date as unverified and asked that nobody treat 8 April as confirmed until the account owner checks it against the contract or CRM.

I didn't record the date anywhere else, and I didn't use `search_messages` or look outside what Pree can see. No approval was needed, since a renewal date is an operational fact rather than a finance figure.
